text: The customer reported that a smart plug from order LM-47720 damaged their extension board and requested to speak with a manager immediately after failing to reach support by phone. The previous agent collected the order number, flagged the case for a duty manager callback, and offered a ₹500 apology coupon, which the customer declined. Next, the duty manager needs to call the customer within 24 hours to resolve the issue.
